integrity: Two exact arithmetic implementations reproduced the section and pencil lists and independently checked the geometric base eliminants; no independent external assessment or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the split degree-six del Pezzo surface over F2 and the F2-rational members of its anticanonical systems are classified; the existence of an earlier unindexed geometric-base classification cannot be excluded.
title: Two all-smooth pencil orbits and Frobenius-six base schemes on the split degree-six del Pezzo surface over \(\mathbf F_2\)
